comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_USEFULNESS_BRIDGE_READINESS_20261109 — LQ-20261107-1670. The cio-governed-bridge was restarted by activation under the 14:15 ET 2026-11-09 slot (journal: Stopping 14:16:52, Started 14:16:54 — two seconds). That killed the rating in flight (RemoteDisconnected) and refused the next seven (URLError [Errno 111]); the 5.8 s run counted eight row failures, exited 1, and the lane's single-attempt policy dead-lettered the slot for two seconds of downtime (d:hermes-usefulness-backfill:live:20261109T1415, scored_now 0).

The lane now waits a transport refusal out inside the run on a bounded schedule (2+4+8+16+30+60+60 = 180 s, well inside the hourly slot), records one line per episode in data/runtime/hermes_bridge_readiness.jsonl, and aborts ONCE with abort_reason bridge_not_ready and exit 75 (EX_TEMPFAIL) when the bridge never returns -- instead of spending the queue marking rows FAILED_PROVIDER. Governance refusals (BRIDGE_ROUTE_REFUSED, COST_CAP, PEAK_SKIP, 4xx) stay terminal and are never waited on.

Hermetic: a fake connection, a fake rating call, an injected sleeper and a temp state root. No DB, no network, no model, no credential, no live symbol or dollar amount. The contract row is config/self_healing_mechanisms.json id hermes_usefulness_bridge_readiness, which the maturity dimension 6 validator checks.
